_namespace.description: a vocabulary: the package or app whose document declares words or extends them. Its eid is the document's $id; its doc.title is its name, its doc.body its description

name.description: its label: a package's name (@yaks/model) or an app's address (yourname/trip)

_comp.description: a component a vocabulary declares: one aspect an entity carries. Its doc.title is its name, its doc.body its description

name.description: its label: the name a bundle writes it under

former.description: the labels it was declared under before, oldest first: each still reads as it in its namespace until another word takes it

namespace.description: the namespace whose vocabulary declares it

wire.description: false = clients read it and never write it

embed.description: false = an entity wearing it is never embedded: no vector is made of it

computed.description: true = no table holds it: its entities are another package's rows, read and never written

sync.description: who is told about a write to it

durable.description: how long one of its values lives: forever, connection, or a duration

pace.description: how often a writer's value is taken, as a duration

search.description: the text its entities are found by, as comp.prop names of another component

identity.description: the properties, in order, its entities' ids are derived from

unique.description: the property lists no two of its rows share

constraints.description: numeric bounds over a whole row

keywords.description: every other keyword its entry says, as written: another package's (prefix, by_name, edge) and JSON Schema's own

_kind.description: a kind a vocabulary declares: the components that make an entity that kind of thing, and what a whole one also carries. Its doc.title is its title, or its name where it has none; its doc.body its description

name.description: its label: the name .kind= and an entity's kind answer it by

namespace.description: the namespace whose vocabulary declares it

is.description: the components an entity carries to be this kind

with.description: what a whole one also carries, by component: true where its writer supplies it, or the values a rule gives it where it is missing

prefix.description: the letter its human ids are numbered in (@yaks/id)

_effect.description: an effect a vocabulary declares: what a commit owes a run of, by name (@yaks/effects runs it). Its doc.title is its name, its doc.body its description

name.description: the name a recorded run names, and the code that runs it is registered under

namespace.description: the namespace whose vocabulary declares it

created.description: the components whose appearance on an entity owes a run

changed.description: the components, or comp.prop properties, whose patch owes a run

removed.description: the components whose removal owes a run

match.description: a query that owes a run wherever a batch made it hold

target.description: the query a trigger's subject matches, before or after the write, for a commit to owe a run

eligible.description: the query a subject must match after the write and when dispatched

active.description: the query that must match an entity for a commit to owe a run

start.description: true = a run is owed each time a process starts working the effects

option.description: the declaring plugin's boolean option that must be true for a run to be owed

tries.description: the most attempts a run gets before it is left failed

idempotent.description: false = running it twice is not the same as running it once

keywords.description: every other keyword its entry says, as written

_prop.description: a property of a component. Its doc.title is comp.prop, its doc.body its description

former.description: the labels it was declared under before, oldest first: each still reads as it on its component until another property takes it

ord.description: its position among the properties its entry declares, from 0

namespace.description: the namespace whose vocabulary declares it: the component's own, or one that extends it

type.description: the JSON type it holds, or a union of them: string, number, integer, boolean, object, array

format.description: what a string or number means: date-time, uri, query, json, priority

enum.description: the closed set of values it holds

const.description: the one value it may hold

default.description: what a row holds when its writer supplied nothing; {"now": true} is the clock

ref.description: the component a reference names; entity is any

death.description: what deleting the referenced entity does to this one

stamped.description: true = the server owns it: clients read it, never write it

reads.description: on a computed property, the components on other entities it reads

unique.description: true = no two rows share it

identity.description: true = its entity's id is derived from it

validate.description: true = a write is checked against its whole JSON Schema

aliases.description: input forms that resolve to an enum member

properties.description: the declared structure of an object value, as written

items.description: the declared structure of an array's elements, as written

keywords.description: every other keyword it says, as written: another package's (store) and JSON Schema's own (minLength, maximum)

_before.description: the edge from a _kind to a _kind it sorts before, where containment does not settle it; edge.ord keeps the order its entry lists them in

_extends.description: a namespace's extension of a component another namespace declares. The properties it adds are _prop rows; its doc.title is comp+namespace, its doc.body its description

namespace.description: the namespace whose vocabulary extends it

status.description: the rungs it adds to the component's status ladder, in order: each component to the status it gives

_vocab.description: the vocabulary the other rows describe, as a whole: one entity per graph, whose hash says what they were last brought into line with, so a graph already describing it is known to without reading them

hash.description: the SHA-256 of every row as the vocabulary described them
